summary: No new receipt this turn, so I finished the account's presentation and evidence trail. The interpretation now leads with its current account — trigger, the three consequence classes with their receipts, the boundary that a covering snapshot or the flag default removes every observation, and the repair paths — instead of opening with the chronological receipt narrative, while the full narrative, the causal argument for why the competing-majority outcome belongs to the stale base rather than the partition, and the fourth client-contract consequence all remain. I also added the two mechanism locators that were only implicit: the new configuration entering the leader's commitment on append (raft.go 1236-1241), which lets the silently created member set be acknowledged by the stale leader plus one other node, and appendEntries clearing a conflicting log suffix on term mismatch (raft.go 1522-1553), which removes the entry the stale leader had committed once the higher-term leader reaches it, plus the vote freshness checks (raft.go 1731-1746, 1812-1828) that keep the removed voter from winning on its own. With all registered gaps resolved, the record now reads as a single current account rather than a sequence of updates.
